observed: Contains(10, 20, 20) returns true for an exclusive upper endpoint.
reproduction: go run ./cmd/contains 10 20 20 prints true and exits zero on the seed.
root_cause: window/interval.go uses <= for the upper endpoint rather than <.
invariant: [start, end) includes start only when start < end, and always excludes end.
fix: Compare start <= value && value < end without subtracting int64 values.
